info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Point of Service Banking API
info.description: The Point of Service Banking API provides essential functionalities for accessing banking services across various channels. This API enables users to retrieve detailed information related to point of service interactions, including transaction history and service availability. It is primarily designed for financial institutions and developers working on banking applications that require seamless integration of multi-channel service access. Typical consumers include app developers, bank service managers, and fintech solutions that aim to enhance customer engagement and transaction efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve information for point of service RES-100045.
get.description: This endpoint retrieves detailed information about the point of service identified by RES-100045. It provides insights into the attributes and status of this particular point of service, enabling effective management and operation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information relevant to the specified point-of-service operation identified by RES-100045. The data structure should conform to the defined JSON schema to ensure successful processing of the request.
